page.layout: Heading "INDEX" at top, centred. Two columns of index entries, left column then right column, the right column ending with a Greek letter heading and entry. Below the columns, one closing line of text set in two lines, centred.

main_text.head: INDEX
main_text.p: Finis Indicis in Titulum ff. De verborum significatione.

page.notes: Printed "Vafa vinaria" read as Vasa (long s printed as f). "Vitus nomine" and ".234.§.fin." are two printed lines of one entry. The Greek entry "Τόξευμα" is uncertain; the printed form is "To'ξευμα" and the accent is doubtful. Column numbers are copied as printed; the entry "1.2.87.239.§.6" is read as printed.
